description: This file defines a custom Gson serializer for the ExternalId class in the Apache Fineract project. It provides logic to serialize ExternalId instances into JSON, returning null for empty or null ExternalIds.

classes.name: ExternalIdAdapter
classes.description: A Gson serializer class for ExternalId objects, converting them into JSON primitives or null.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an ExternalId object into a JSON element, returning null if the object is null or empty, otherwise returning the value as a JSON primitive.
